##### Project general facts

Five Palm Jumeirah is a luxury hotel and residential development located on the trunk of Palm Jumeirah, one of the world’s most iconic man-made islands. The project features a ground floor and 15 residential levels, offering a mix of hotel rooms and fully furnished residences with panoramic views over the Arabian Gulf. Its contemporary architecture and prime waterfront position create a vibrant resort-style living experience in the heart of Dubai.

Residents benefit from a wide range of world-class amenities, including a private beach, indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, spa facilities, children’s play areas, BBQ zones, and 24-hour concierge and security services.

The residences include studios as well as 1- to 4-bedroom apartments, all designed with high-quality finishes, modern furnishings, and floor-to-ceiling windows that maximize natural light and sea views. Each unit is equipped with fitted wardrobes and fully fitted kitchens, while the exclusive 4-bedroom Sky Villas feature expansive terraces with private plunge pools, offering a more elevated and private lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Palm Jumeirah offers a range of world-class amenities and attractions. One of the most famous landmarks is the Atlantis, The Palm, a five-star resort located at the apex of the palm tree. It features an Aquaventure Waterpark, The Lost Chambers Aquarium, and a variety of luxury accommodations and dining options.

Palm Jumeirah is also home to a vibrant marina, where residents and visitors can enjoy yachting, boating, and other water activities. The crescent-shaped breakwater is lined with luxury hotels, resorts, and beach clubs that offer stunning views of the Dubai skyline.

Transportation on the island is facilitated by monorail, which connects Palm Jumeirah to the mainland, providing easy access to other parts of Dubai. The island is also well-connected by road networks and offers ample parking spaces for residents and guests.
